sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.tagline: 20 verbs, as fast as you can.
sprint.intro: Pick the right form for 20 verbs. Wrong answer = 3-second penalty. Can you set a new best time?

type_race.name: Type Race
type_race.tagline: Type all three forms. Beat the clock.
type_race.intro: You see the base form. Type the Simple Past and Past Participle, then press Enter. 10 verbs, one clock.

drag_match.name: Drag Match
drag_match.tagline: Match the base form, Simple Past and Past Participle.
drag_match.intro: Drag each form to the matching base form. You can also tap: first tap the base form, then the matching form. A wrong match costs 2 seconds. Two stages: first the Simple Past, then the Past Participle.

fill_gap.name: Fill the Gap
fill_gap.intro: 10 sentences, each with one gap. Read the sentence, work out the tense and type the right form. Press Enter to submit.

verb_diplom.name: Verb Diploma
verb_diplom.tagline: The test with a certificate: bronze, silver, gold.

falling_forms.name: Falling Forms
falling_forms.tagline: Tap the right form before the block hits the bottom.
falling_forms.intro: Blocks fall from the top. Each block shows two forms. Tap the right one before the block hits the ground. You have 3 lives. Endless mode.

flashcards.name: Flashcards
flashcards.tagline: Classic learning, at your own pace.
flashcards.intro: Front: the base form. Tap the card to flip it. Then be honest: did you know it, or do you need more practice?
flashcards.deck_empty: No cards in this deck — choose a different filter.
flashcards.deck_finished: Deck done! Want to go again?

reference.search_placeholder: Search for a rule or example…

category_descriptions.time: When something happens: in, on, at, since, for, by, during.
category_descriptions.place: Where something is: in, on, at, between, next to, under.
category_descriptions.movement: Where something is going: to, into, onto, from, through, across.
category_descriptions.adjective: Fixed adjective + preposition pairs like 'afraid of', 'good at'.
category_descriptions.verb: Fixed verb + preposition pairs like 'wait for', 'depend on'.
category_descriptions.noun: Fixed noun + preposition pairs like 'reason for', 'example of'.
category_descriptions.transport: How you get around: by bus, on foot, in a car.
category_descriptions.phrase: Fixed phrases with a preposition: on time, by accident, for example.

classes.join_lead: Type the code your teacher gave you and your first name.
classes.nick_hint: First name only. If two pupils in your class share it, add the first letter of your surname, e.g. “Mia S.”
classes.taken_q: This class already has “{name}”. Is that you?
classes.taken_hint: Then add the first letter of your surname, e.g. “Mia S.”
classes.joined_lead: Everything you answer in games and practice now is seen by your teacher, so they know which words to practice.
classes.err_code: That code doesn't exist. Check it again.
classes.quiz_code: That's a Quiz Room code – taking you there …
classes.err_net: No connection. Try again in a moment.
classes.err_many: Too many tries. Wait a moment.
classes.create_lead: You get a code for the class and a private link to your overview. No account and no email needed.
classes.pupil_link: Link for the class (share it in Moodle, Teams, Classroom …)
classes.your_link: Your private link to the overview
classes.your_link_warn: Bookmark this link. Whoever has it sees the class. Without an account it is the only way in.
classes.no_token: This class doesn't exist (any more). The link is incomplete or the class was deleted.
classes.hard: Words the class still finds hard
classes.hard_none: No hard words yet – or too few answers so far.
classes.remove_q: Remove {name} from the class? Their answers will be deleted.
classes.no_pupils: Nobody has joined yet. Give the class the code or the link.
classes.del_q: Delete the class with all names and answers for good?
classes.retention: Without activity, the class is deleted automatically after {days} days.
classes.save_lead: Enter your email and find your classes again on any device.
classes.save_note: No password: you get a link by email. The class also works without this.
classes.sent_html: We've sent a link to {email}. Open it on this or another device and the class is saved. It works once and for {minutes} minutes.
classes.sent_signin_html: We've sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and for {minutes} minutes.
classes.err_email: Please enter a valid email address.
classes.saved_other: This class is saved to an account.
classes.attach_q: You are signed in. Add this class to “My classes”?
classes.attached: Added. You'll now find the class under “My classes”.
classes.err_taken: This class is already saved to another account.
classes.account_lead: Sign in with your email to see your classes on any device. No password: you get a link by email.
classes.no_account_note: An account is optional: you can also create a class without signing in and without an email.
classes.link_bad: This link has expired or was already used. Just ask for a new one.
classes.claimed: The class is now saved to your account.
classes.claim_failed: Signed in. The class was already saved to another account and was not added.
classes.no_classes_yet: No classes in your account yet. Create a new one or add an existing one with its secret link.
classes.detach_q: Remove “{name}” from your account? The class stays and still opens with its secret link.
classes.device_lead: These classes were opened on this device. Add them to your account to see them everywhere.
classes.add_link_lead: Paste the class's secret link (your bookmark), or open it and tap “Add to my account” there.
classes.err_link: That isn't a valid class link.
classes.delete_account_lead: Deletes your email address and the connection to your classes. The classes themselves stay and keep working with their secret link. If you no longer have a class's link, create a new one in its overview first.
classes.delete_account_q: Delete your account and email address for good? The classes still open with their secret link.
classes.account_deleted: Your account has been deleted. The classes keep working with their secret link.
classes.err_tutor_space: This email also has a tutor space. Delete the space on the tutor page first, or write to us at hello@krabsy.com.
classes.account_retention: An account without classes is deleted automatically after {days} days without signing in.
classes.signin_to_open: This class is saved to an account. Sign in to open it.
classes.secret_lead: Your account opens this class. The secret link works as well, even without signing in. If it was passed on, replace it: the old link then stops working.
classes.secret_q: Create a new secret link? The current link stops working.
classes.secret_done: Your new secret link. Keep it in case you ever want to open the class without an account:
classes.created_saved: The class is saved to your account. You'll find it on any device under “My classes”.
classes.secret_optional: Secret link to the overview (works without signing in too)
